verification.notes: Draft, not reviewed by a UNEB or NCDC officer. Confirmed from a UNEB document: the PLE reports divisions 1, 2, 3, 4, U and X. Taken from platform spec 03 Appendix D and not confirmed against a UNEB source: four examined subjects (English, Mathematics, Science, Social Studies), grades D1 (1) to F9 (9), aggregate 4 to 36. NOT confirmed (UNEB's live site was unreachable and its archived pages carry no grading rules): the division ranges (I 4-12, II 13-23, III 24-29, IV 30-34, U 35-36), the percent boundaries of the nine grades, the school-internal CA/exam weights, the term windows, and whether a failed English or Mathematics caps the division (no fail_if rule is modelled). The grade-to-percent scale is a school-overridable default, not a UNEB boundary: UNEB awards PLE grades itself from the candidate's marks.
